name: Portrait Mode
summary: Portrait Mode is browser-based party game for 2-6 players. Players begin by taking a selfie, then take turns drawing portraits of each other across multiple rounds, starting with basic outlines and building up to color and detail. The results are revealed at the end for the group to enjoy. Best played in person or on a call with friends.
